dct_description_sm: Statements by pest managers. The declaration forms have been submitted since July 5, 2011. The data has a low degree of reliability because it is recorded manually by third parties, i.e. pest managers and *is not subject to any validation by the City of Montréal*.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
